rule.name: UnquotedRegexValue
rule.message: Wrap the runtime value in Pattern.quote(value), also when you join it into a Pattern.compile pattern, and use replace(text, replacement) instead of replaceAll for a literal replacement; a value meant as a whole pattern goes to Pattern.compile(pattern) on its own. String.split, matches, replaceAll and replaceFirst compile their argument as a regex, so a dot, pipe, dollar sign or other metacharacter in the value changes what matches.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $quote := 'java.util.regex.Pattern#quote(java.lang.String)', $constants := //FieldDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static'][pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final'] /VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name return ( //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.String#split(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.String#splitWithDelimiters(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.String#matches(java.lang.String)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.String#replaceAll(java.lang.String,java.lang.String)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.String#replaceFirst(java.lang.String,java.lang.String)')] /ArgumentList/*[1] | //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.regex.Pattern#compile(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.regex.Pattern#matches(java.lang.String,java.lang.CharSequence)')] /ArgumentList/*[1][self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+']] )[let $argument := . return descendant-or-self::* [not(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+'])] [ancestor::*[not(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+'])][1] is $argument/..] [pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String')] [not(@CompileTimeConstant = true())] [not(self::MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig($quote)])] [not(descendant-or-self::MethodReference[@MethodName = 'quote'] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.regex.Pattern')]])] [descendant-or-self::*[self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess[*[1][self::ThisExpression]]] [not(@Name = $constants)][not(matches(@Name, '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$'))] [not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Number') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Boolean') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Character') or pmd-java:typeIs('int') or pmd-java:typeIs('long') or pmd-java:typeIs('short') or pmd-java:typeIs('byte') or pmd-java:typeIs('char') or pmd-java:typeIs('boolean') or pmd-java:typeIs('double') or pmd-java:typeIs('float'))] [not(ancestor::MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig($quote)])] [not(ancestor::*[not(preceding-sibling::*)][parent::ConditionalExpression] [some $node in ancestor::* satisfies $node is $argument])] [not(self::VariableAccess/@Name = ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1] //VariableDeclarator[*[2][@CompileTimeConstant = true() or descendant-or-self::MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig($quote)] or descendant-or-self::MethodReference[@MethodName = 'quote']]] /VariableId/@Name)]]]
